gaps.quote: multiplying by $-\varepsilon_w$ again removes the sign
gaps.note: Wrong sign. The route multiplies the array by eps_w in {+1,-1}; to remove it one multiplies by eps_w again (eps_w^2=1), not by -eps_w, which would leave a factor -1 on every role with eps_w=+1. It also contradicts the next claim that scratch roles (sign +1) need no correction. The paper (lines 1312-1313) only negates the outputs that carry the minus sign, i.e. multiplies by eps_w.

gaps.quote: on arrays indexed by the common address set
gaps.note: The page never says which address set is common or why all roles have the same one; the paper (lines 126-128) says all role streams have the same local address set (same remaining shape after the cyclic row split). The row split is not tied to this set.

gaps.quote: The frame $D_\nu$ of the gate is linear and the coefficients are scalars
gaps.note: The identity needs every input and output wire of the gate to use the same frame D_nu (paper line 135: all incidences of one gate have the same frame). The page never states this hypothesis, nor that the scalar coefficients commute with D_nu (R-linearity), so the displayed identity is not justified as written.
